{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the trial data
trial_df = pd.read_csv('/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/trial.csv')

# Drop rows with sentinel values in biomarker_baseline
trial_clean = trial_df[trial_df['biomarker_baseline'] != -999]

# Check the distribution of severity across arms in cleaned data
print('\n--- Severity by Arm in Cleaned Data ---')
print(trial_clean.groupby('arm')['severity'].value_counts())

# Check if severity is balanced across arms
sev_control = trial_clean[trial_clean['arm'] == 'control']['severity'].value_counts()
sev_treatment = trial_clean[trial_clean['arm'] == 'treatment']['severity'].value_counts()

# Compute weighted average of baseline biomarker by severity
print('\n--- Weighted Average Baseline Biomarker by Severity and Arm ---')
weighted_avg = trial_clean.groupby(['severity', 'arm'])['biomarker_baseline'].mean()
print(weighted_avg)

# Check if the imbalance in severity affects the response rate comparison
print('\n--- Response Rate by Severity and Arm ---')
response_by_sev_arm = trial_clean.groupby(['severity', 'arm'])['responded'].mean()
print(response_by_sev_arm)"}
